title: Quantum Query Complexity and Span Programs from Pre-Geometry
summary: Span programs provide a general method for designing quantum query algorithms, and for Boolean coordinate queries their optimum cost agrees with the general adversary bound. We develop a matroidal organization of this optimization that separates dependence data determined by the query problem from the dependence structure chosen by a span program. The resulting source matroid records query dependence, target determination, and separation data, while a program matroid records dependencies among the target and response-labeled input elements of a candidate program.
